questiontext.text: Which of the following are recognized contemporary social problems in Nigeria? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Examination malpractice, cultism, HIV/AIDS, and drug abuse are contemporary social vices. Shelterbelts are environmental conservation.

questiontext.text: Which of the following methods CANNOT transmit HIV? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: HIV is not transmitted through desks, handshakes, hugs, sharing food, or swimming pools. It requires direct blood or fluid contact.

questiontext.text: Match each contemporary social problem with its primary danger:

generalfeedback.text: Exam cheating devalues certificates; Cultism brings campus terror; Drug abuse causes psychosis; Trafficking is modern slavery.

questiontext.text: Match each social agency or statute with its primary target:

generalfeedback.text: NDLEA targets drugs; Decree 18 targets exam fraud; Anti-Discrimination Act protects HIV patients; NAPTIP targets human trafficking.
